scientific_claim: Rule-level generalization forms when the next state-conditioned AdamW/weight-decay relaxation burst updates a partially formed rule circuit; later relaxation bursts can transiently exhaust a decaying stability reserve and are followed by optimizer-driven recovery.
primitive_inputs: capability_evaluation facts bound to exact parameter versions
validation logits and validation targets from their exact evaluation occurrences
gradient_total_norm facts from exact gradient-global-norm occurrences

operative_state.rule_progress: Latest validation accuracy and recent positive grid increment; executed in the pre-burst curve update.
operative_state.rule_margin: Median exact validation correct-vs-strongest-other logit margin; executed in the formation-burst response.
operative_state.oscillator_phase: Last three significant gradient-burst centers and their two intervals; executed in prediction of the next burst.
operative_state.optimizer_decay_law: Learning rate times decoupled weight decay sets the asymptotic burst period and reserve decay.
operative_state.stability_reserve: Current tied token/output-weight norm divided by its prefix maximum; executed in the recurrent-degradation test.

update_law.early_period: When the observed period remains below 0.85 of the optimizer-conditioned asymptote and is growing, p_next = p + 0.84*(p-p_previous).
update_law.formation_response: At the first evaluation grid point after the predicted burst, update rule progress with 0.75 + 0.35*pre_burst_progress plus the bounded operative margin correction; subsequently relax toward 0.995.
update_law.reserve: At each predicted post-formation burst multiply reserve by exp(-0.064*(learning_rate*weight_decay/0.003)).
update_law.recovery: A severe low-reserve burst produces a one-grid degradation state followed by RECOVERY and return to the generalized attractor.

calibration_classification.uncertainty: One discovery execution cannot establish cross-execution invariance; the 200-step and 500-step intervals expose timing uncertainty and the sealed candidate requires prospective evaluation.
